description: Dependency updates for sealambda/chironium. sealambda/infra runs Renovate for every repository of the organization (its record 0021).

schedule: before 10am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Mix: only what the requirements in mix.exs already allow, as mix deps.update moves mix.lock; a person widens a requirement by hand.
Mix: one pull request for the minor and patch versions.
pnpm: one pull request for the minor and patch versions.
Phoenix ships each JavaScript client both in its Hex package and on npm. assets/package.json pins the npm copy to the version in mix.lock, so both move in one pull request.
The actions that .github/workflows pins by commit SHA, with the version in a comment: one pull request for all of them.
A new major version of a pnpm dependency waits on the Dependency Dashboard until a person ticks it.
